messages.subject: Project Cedar — mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Nathan,

Further to the parties' discussions, please find attached a draft mutual NDA to enable Larkmoor and Verrell to exchange confidential information in connection with the proposed licence. It is in fairly standard form (five-year term, mutual, usual carve-outs).

Grateful for any comments; otherwise we'd suggest getting this signed promptly so we can share the technical materials.

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar — mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. We're content with the NDA as drafted — no changes. Caroline has signed on our side and I attach our counterpart. Please arrange for Larkmoor to countersign and we'll treat it as effective from today, 8 October.

Look forward to receiving the patent schedule and the know-how summary.

Nathan Holt
General Counsel, Verrell Beauty Group plc
